source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Why should important original evidence remain available after conversation compaction?

options.text: The summary guarantees that every source will be reopened automatically.
options.feedback: A summary does not guarantee later retrieval. Keeping source locations and originals available makes reopening possible when a detail is needed.

options.text: The summary turns earlier tentative claims into verified project facts.
options.feedback: Summarizing a claim does not validate it. Original evidence may be needed to check whether a tentative statement was established.

options.text: The summary can omit details that later become relevant.
options.feedback: Compaction selects what to preserve in a shorter account. Original evidence lets you recover a detail that the summary did not retain.

options.text: The summary requires all originals to be pasted into every later request.
options.feedback: Sources can remain accessible without being included in every input. Reopen the evidence needed for the next step.
